name: flightmode
description: Soft-block WiFi and Bluetooth and keep them blocked across reboot
author: Just a Nerd

volumio_info.details: Turns WiFi and Bluetooth off with rfkill and keeps them off across reboot. No OS files are overwritten; stopping or uninstalling the plugin removes the units and releases the radios.
volumio_info.changelog: 1.0.0: Independent WiFi and Bluetooth toggles; flight mode is the master for both
